messages:
Nora: quick follow-up from this morning's partial outage — vendor auth latency + slow model-registry list caused regen timeouts for ~7m. Need owners for remediation actions.
Ethan: root cause looks like token endpoint throttling + paginated list backpressure. I'll own a short-term mitigation: local registry snapshot refreshed every 5m and served read-only on failover. Owner: Ethan. ETA: 48h.
Priya: I'll implement per-instance token cache with randomized refresh jitter + small backoff to prevent stampedes. Owner: Priya. ETA: 72h.
oncall-bot: deploy-bot: snapshot-refresher canary deployed at 2201234300
vendor-eng: we'll export auth latency histograms and request IDs for the window. Also open to adding token p95 SLA.
Nora: I'll update the postmortem with owners + add a runbook step: if vendor token p95 > 1s for 5m, enable snapshot fallback and notify vendor AM. Owner: Nora. ETA: Tomorrow.
Ethan: adding a metric: registry-snapshot-fallback-rate + SLO alert. Owner: Ethan. ETA: 24h.
Priya: adding circuit-breaker on list calls with config proposal in PR. Owner: Priya. ETA: 48h.
Nora: action summary in PIR doc:
- Ethan: registry snapshot automation + fallback metric (48h)
- Priya: token cache + list-call circuit-breaker (72h)
- Nora: runbook + vendor trace request + PIR invite (Tomorrow)
Please react :eyes: to accept or :raised_hand: to swap. We'll do a 15m sync after owners ack.
Ethan: :eyes:
Priya: :eyes: need to pair with SRE on canary schedule, might slide 1d.
Nora: noted, please update the doc if timeline shifts.
